messages.subject: Moderation with WARNING variance
parts:
Hello,

I tried to run a moderation analysis. I checked for categorial variables (gender [0;1] and experience [0;1]) and age (int). I used the approach to calculate the interaction effect by using the scores * moderator.

Naturally, the variance for the age moderator is considerably larger than for the other variables.

Any recommendations?


Thank you
Carsten


Moderation.scores <- "
            # Measurement Model
                Nutzung  =~ NB01_01 + NB01_03 + NB01_05 + NB01_09
                LE       =~ LE01_01 + LE01_02 + LE01_03 + LE01_04
                AE       =~ AE01_01 + AE01_02 + AE01_03 + AE01_04
                SN       =~ SN01_01 + SN01_02 + SN01_03 + SN01_04
                TA       =~ TA01_01 + TA01_02 + TA01_04 + TA01_05 + TA01_07 + TA01_09
                IB       =~  IB01_03U + IB01_05U + IB01_08U # + IB01_01 + IB01_02
                DB       =~ DB01_01 + DB01_02 + DB01_03
                Age      =~ DE02_01

            # interaction terms
                GxLE    =~ Z_GxLE
                GxSN    =~ Z_GxSN
                # GxAE    =~ Z_GxAE
                # GxTA    =~ Z_GxTA
                # GxIB    =~ Z_GxIB
                # GxDB    =~ Z_GxDB

                AxLE    =~ Z_AxLE
                AxAE    =~ Z_AxAE
                AxSN    =~ Z_AxSN
                AxTA    =~ Z_AxTA
                AxIB    =~ Z_AxIB
                AxDB    =~ Z_AxDB

                # ExLE    =~ Z_ExLE
                # ExAE    =~ Z_ExAE
                # ExSN    =~ Z_ExSN
                # ExDB    =~ Z_ExDB
                ExTA    =~ Z_ExTA
                ExIB    =~ Z_ExIB

            # regressions
                Nutzung ~ LE + AE + SN + TA + DB + IB + Age
                           + GxLE + GxSN # + GxAE + GxTA + GxIB + GxDB
                           + AxLE + AxAE + AxSN + AxTA + AxIB + AxDB
                           + ExTA + ExIB # + ExLE + ExAE + ExSN + ExDB

            # residual correlations
"

parts:
You could divide age by 10, so the slopes are interpreted with respect to 10-year rather than 1-year changes.
